subject: Physics
title: Atoms
summary: Rutherford ke alpha-scattering experiment se pata chala ki atom ka saara positive charge aur lagbhag saara mass ek bahut chhote nucleus (~10⁻¹⁵ m) mein hai; baaki atom zyaadatar khaali hai.
Rutherford model ki problem: ghoomta electron radiation karke nucleus mein gir jaana chahiye, aur spectrum continuous hona chahiye. Asal mein atom stable hai aur spectrum lines wala hai.

Bohr ne kaha: electron sirf kuch khaas orbits mein ghoom sakta hai jahaan L = nh/2π; un orbits mein wo radiate nahi karta. Ek orbit se doosre mein koodne par hi photon nikalta/absorb hota hai: hν = E_upper − E_lower.
Hydrogen-like atom (H, He⁺, Li²⁺) ke liye: r ∝ n²/Z, v ∝ Z/n, E ∝ −Z²/n². Inhi se poora hydrogen spectrum (Lyman, Balmer, Paschen…) nikal aata hai.

formulas.name: Distance of closest approach
formulas.formula: r₀ = k (2e)(Ze) / K   (alpha ki KE = K, head-on)
formulas.when: Alpha particle nucleus ke kitna paas aa sakta hai — nucleus ke size ki upper limit.
formulas.mistake: Alpha ka charge 2e hai, e nahi.

formulas.name: Impact parameter
formulas.formula: b = k Z e² cot(θ/2) / K   (alpha, KE = K);   b = 0 ⇒ θ = 180° (seedha wapas)
formulas.when: Scattering angle aur impact parameter ka relation.

formulas.name: Rutherford scattering
formulas.when: Kis angle par kitne alpha particles mudte hain.
formulas.mistake: Bahut kam particles bade angle par mudte hain.

formulas.name: Radius of nth orbit
formulas.mistake: r ∝ n²: n = 2 par 4 guna, n = 3 par 9 guna.

formulas.name: Speed in nth orbit
formulas.mistake: v ∝ 1/n: upar ke orbit mein dheema.

formulas.name: Time period, frequency, current
formulas.formula: T ∝ n³/Z²,   f ∝ Z²/n³,   current I = ef ∝ Z²/n³

formulas.name: Photon in a transition
formulas.formula: hν = E_{n₂} − E_{n₁};   1/λ = R Z² (1/n₁² − 1/n₂²),   R = 1.097 × 10⁷ m⁻¹
formulas.mistake: n₂ > n₁ hamesha; R wala formula hydrogen-like atoms ke liye hi.

formulas.name: Spectral series of hydrogen
formulas.formula: Lyman n₁ = 1 (UV) · Balmer n₁ = 2 (visible) · Paschen n₁ = 3 (IR) · Brackett 4 (IR) · Pfund 5 (IR)

formulas.name: Series limits
formulas.formula: Shortest λ (series limit): n₂ = ∞ ⇒ 1/λ = RZ²/n₁².  Longest λ: n₂ = n₁ + 1
formulas.when: Kisi series ki sabse chhoti/badi wavelength.

formulas.name: Number of spectral lines
formulas.formula: n se neeche aane par total lines = n(n − 1)/2
formulas.mistake: Ek hi atom ek baar mein max (n − 1) lines deta hai.

formulas.name: Ionisation and excitation energy
formulas.formula: Ionisation (ground se): 13.6 Z² eV.  H ki first excitation (1 → 2): 10.2 eV,  1 → 3: 12.09 eV
formulas.mistake: Ionisation potential volt mein (13.6 V), energy eV mein.

formulas.name: de Broglie view of Bohr orbit
formulas.when: Bohr ki shart ka wave wala matlab: orbit mein poori waves fit hon.

examples.title: Alpha kitna paas aayega?
examples.problem: 7.7 MeV ka alpha particle gold (Z = 79) nucleus ki taraf seedha aata hai. Closest approach?
examples.solution: r₀ = k(2e)(79e)/K. K = 7.7 × 10⁶ × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J. r₀ = 9 × 10⁹ × 158 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ / 7.7 × 10⁶ ≈ 3.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ m (≈ 30 fm). Nucleus isse bhi chhota hai.

topics.title: Alpha-particle scattering (Geiger–Marsden)
topics.explain: Patli gold foil par alpha particles maare. Zyaadatar seedhe nikal gaye (atom khaali hai); kuch bade angle par mude; bahut kam (lagbhag 8000 mein se 1) 90° se zyada mude, kuch seedhe wapas bhi aaye — matlab chhota, bhaari, positive nucleus. Gold isliye ki bahut patla (pitkar) banta hai.

topics.title: Rutherford model aur uski kamiyaan
topics.explain: Nucleus beech mein, electrons ghoomte hain (planetary model). Kamiyaan: accelerating charge radiation karega to electron spiral karke gir jaayega (atom unstable), aur spectrum continuous hona chahiye — jo nahi hota.

topics.title: Bohr ke teen postulates
topics.explain: (1) Electron kuch stationary orbits mein bina radiation ke ghoomta hai. (2) Wo orbits jinmein L = nh/2π. (3) Orbit badalne par photon: hν = E_i − E_f. Bohr model sirf ek-electron wale atoms (H, He⁺, Li²⁺) par sahi kaam karta hai.

topics.title: Energy level diagram
topics.explain: Levels upar jaate-jaate paas aate jaate hain (E ∝ −1/n²). Ground state n = 1 (−13.6 eV), first excited n = 2 (−3.4 eV), n = 3 (−1.51 eV), … n = ∞ (0 eV).

topics.title: Hydrogen spectrum
topics.explain: Emission spectrum = upar se neeche koodne par bright lines; absorption = neeche se upar, dark lines. Lyman UV mein, Balmer visible mein (Hα laal 656 nm), Paschen aur aage IR mein.

topics.title: Bohr model ki limitations
topics.explain: Multi-electron atoms ka spectrum nahi samjha sakta, lines ki intensity nahi bata sakta, aur fine structure nahi samjhaata. Ye semi-classical model hai.

topics.title: Scaling with Z aur n
topics.explain: r ∝ n²/Z, v ∝ Z/n, E ∝ Z²/n², T ∝ n³/Z², f ∝ Z²/n³. Ratio wale sawal inhi se ek line mein.

ratta: Eₙ = −13.6 Z²/n² eV;  rₙ = 0.529 n²/Z Å;  vₙ = 2.18 × 10⁶ Z/n m/s.
R = 1.097 × 10⁷ m⁻¹;  Lyman limit 91.2 nm;  Hα 656 nm.
Series: Lyman 1 (UV), Balmer 2 (visible), Paschen 3, Brackett 4, Pfund 5 (IR).
H: ionisation 13.6 eV, first excitation 10.2 eV.  He⁺: 54.4 eV.
